description: WATZS threat keyword configuration. Keywords organized by alert level.

L2.name: Medium Alert
L2.description: Suspicious activity keywords or abnormal sound

keyword_repetition_to_L3.description: Any L1 or L2 keyword repeated more than 2 times escalates to L3

any_word_repetition_to_L2.description: Any word (not just keywords) repeated 3 or more times triggers L2 alert

combined_L1_L2_to_L3.description: L1 + L2 alert occurring within time window escalates to L3

secret_code_to_L3.description: Secret voice code spoken 3 times in succession triggers L3
